# Three.js vendor files

- Version: 0.180.0
- Source: the official Three.js package distribution (`build/three.module.js`, `build/three.core.js`, `examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js`, `examples/jsm/loaders/OBJLoader.js`, `examples/jsm/loaders/MTLLoader.js`, `examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js`, and `examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js`).
- The example modules import `three.module.js` through local relative paths so the site does not need a CDN at runtime.
